finding: The first local four-pair ABBA driver draft selected the upper-middle observation after sorting four improvement percentages. That is not the conventional even-sample median and could over-credit a noisy positive transfer.
required_repair_before_execution: Use the arithmetic mean of the two middle observations for four-pair median wall and CPU improvement. Do not execute or credit the earlier draft.
scientific_effect: No measured child/product result is changed because the driver has not executed on repository/hosted product state.
preregistered_kill_law_unchanged: Any boundary/archive/selection mismatch OR non-positive median wall improvement in either co-critical child retires native FastCDC as a first-order shared-child route.
claim_boundary: Evidence-harness correction only; no product or release credit.
